myShift.title: My shift
myShift.subtitle: Open the till at the start of your shift, and count the drawer at the end.
myShift.errorMsg: Could not check whether a shift is open.
myShift.offlineBody: Starting and ending a shift needs a connection, because the drawer is counted on the server. You can keep selling — the sales will sync when you're back.

none.title: No shift is open
none.body: Start your shift to open the till and put today's takings in your drawer.

other.title: {name}'s shift is still open
other.body: Only one shift can be open at a time. Count the drawer and close it, then start yours.
other.cta: Count the drawer and close it

start.title: Start my shift
start.intro: Count what's already in the drawer before you sell anything.
start.floatHint: Carried over from the last shift's count. Change it if the drawer says otherwise.
start.floatHintNoSuggestion: Count the cash in the drawer now and type the total.

close.title: End my shift
close.intro: Count every note and coin in the drawer, then type the total.
close.countedHint: Count first, then type. The difference is shown once the shift is closed.
close.notesPlaceholder: Anything worth explaining — five short, paid a delivery, and so on

gate.title: Start your shift to sell
gate.body: Sales need a shift open so the money lands in someone's drawer.

page.title: Shifts
page.subtitle: Set when the shop trades, then split each day into the shifts your team works.

hours.title: Opening hours
hours.subtitle: When the shop trades. Every shift has to sit inside these hours.
hours.splitHint: Fills the day with equal shifts you can rename and adjust.

grid.title: Weekly shifts
grid.subtitle: Up to four shifts a day. Times are judged against that day's opening hours when you save.
grid.full: Four shifts is the maximum for one day.

slotEditor.name: Name
slotEditor.errSameTime: A shift cannot start and end at the same time.

assign.title: Who works {name}?
assign.intro: Anyone on this rota is expected on this shift. Several people is normal — whoever covers that week.
assign.empty: This shop has no employees yet.

removeSlot.title: Remove this shift?
removeSlot.body: {name} leaves the weekly grid and its rota is cleared. Shifts already worked keep their name.

history.title: Shift history
history.subtitle: Every shift worked, newest trading day first.
history.empty: No shifts match these filters yet.
history.errorMsg: Could not load the shift history.
history.soldVsDrawer: "Sold" is what was rung up; "in the drawer" is the cash that actually reached the till. A credit sale raises one without the other, so a gap between them is normal.

detail.title: Shift on {date}
detail.noReceipts: Nothing was rung up on this shift.
detail.cancelledHint: A receipt cancelled after the close still shows here, while the cash figures stay as they were counted on the night.

report.title: Shift totals
report.subtitle: Sales are counted against whoever rang them up; cash differences against whose shift it was.
report.empty: Nothing to report for this period yet.
report.shortShiftsHint: Shifts that came up short at the count.
